about_the_game:
House Party - Nocturnal Temptations

You asked for one last ride, and frankly, we had an idea that was too hot to ignore. Your favorite house party is getting the epic final chapter it deserves -- a DLC born from the perfect storm of a crazy concept and overwhelming player demand. Welcome to Nocturnal Temptations.

Go Back In Time, Do Weird S**t!

Get ready for a full-blown trip to the 1950s! This time-travelling expansion takes players to a brand new location: A cursed film set in the middle of a massive forest. This ain't just some tromp through the woods -- it's all happening over 70 years ago. 

Your mission: rewrite Hollywood history alongside the long-lost, drop-dead gorgeous starlet, Gisella Gagliano. You'll need to handle crazy cults and moonshining hillbillies to help a silver-screen legend get her second shot at fame in this hot and wild new DLC!

Put Your Stamina To The Test With A Golden Age Bombshell!

Gisella Gagliano isn’t just a pretty face. She’s a visionary creator who was too hot for old Hollywood to handle. Now, she needs a new leading man (or woman) to finish her big picture, and she’s got her eyes on you.

Fix the Past, Don't F**k Up the Future!

Party harder than ever with this insane new House Party expansion pack. Explore a dizzying range of new choices, dialogue options, and bizarre side quests. Recruit new friends and old to help finish Gisella’s movie and uncover the truth of the fabled woods…

The Nocturnal Temptations expansion pack features:

  • A brand new FOREST area to explore, 8x bigger than Madison’s house!

  • Brand new scenes and stories with hundreds of lines of new dialogue.

  • New mechanics, such as weaponizing Compubrah’s “NANO-NUT” technology against the forces of evil! AND FREAKING TIME TRAVEL!

  • Experience brand new, hilarious content for all other base game NPCs as they deal with the consequences of your time-traveling shenanigans.

  • Multiple, game-altering endings.
